title: 第9章 万罗鬼面

content_zh:
大耗子精身边的男子一怔，旋及怒火骤起。他们在法器阁担任职务的，可远非胖道人这种杂司监的人可比，都是有关系或是花了大价钱才钻进来的，手握法宝源脉，门下弟子见了他们，哪个不恭恭敬敬？也正是因为这样，才养成了他们飞扬跋扈的性格。
但是何曾想到，今天只不过小小的训斥了一个刚入门的弟子，他便敢破口大骂？
一时心头火起，这男子直接踏上一步，就想一巴掌抽飞这小子。
方行一看他这模样，便知道这是要动手了，身子往后一退，低声笑道：“你强索贿赂不成，还想跟爷们动手么？道门还有没有规矩？”
这男子陡然色变，硬生生停下了手。
虽然入门的弟子都遵守规矩，心照不宣的把那块灵石给他们，但这事可见不得光。
他看眼前这个小子年龄不大，却一副老油子模样，还真怕他把事捅出去喽……
“哈哈，哈哈，怎么一见面就吵起来了，这可不好……”
大耗子精笑眯眯的看着方行，不怀好意道：“这位小师弟年龄不大，但脾气很烈嘛，罢了，刚才是我们跟你开玩笑的，你这就进去选一件法器吧，眼睛可得擦亮点……”
“多谢师兄！”
方行一抱拳，也不理会这大耗子精话里有话，一脑袋钻了进去。
这进去了一看，却顿时吃了一惊，这哪里是什么法器阁啊，分明是个杂货铺子。
一排排，一架架的木架子，分别放着飞剑、符宝、灵器等物，乍一看去，让人眼花缭乱，每一件看起来似乎都颇为不凡，有的下面还贴着名字，以及小字的介绍，有的则根本就是那架子上一堆，乱七八糟的符篆、飞剑、宝瓶甚至连罗盘都有，也看不出是好是坏。
到了这时，方行终于明白为什么每个新晋的外门弟子都心甘情愿的给这几个人贿赂了，因为这里法器实在太多了，从外观上看根本不知道哪一件是好的，哪一件是坏的，更不明白它的作用，如果就这么蒙头蒙脑的在里面随便挑一件，那失手的可能性太大了。
大耗子精及两个师弟见到了方行这呆愣愣的模样，顿时冷笑了起来。
他们也不是没碰到过舍不得交出灵石的，但这些人无一不被他们坑了一通。
这法器阁里虽说都是青云宗外宗弟子可用的低阶法器，但也有两三千件，前不久青云宗召收弟子，已经选走了一大批品质不错的了，如今剩下来的，倒有一大半都是品质低劣，或者直接就是损坏了，无法正常使用的，一些好的也被他们藏到了很难看到的地方。
他们就不信这个顶撞他们的小子能挑到什么好东西！
“哼，这三个王八蛋想坑老子，今天就让你们开开眼界……”
方行回过神来，心下冷笑，慢慢向前走去。

“这位小师弟，每个弟子进来法器阁，都只有一柱香时间挑选，我给你点上了啊……”
大耗子精又笑嘻嘻的说了一声，使眼色让身边的男子去选一根最干燥的计时香点上。
那个男子会意，点香之时，又故意掰下了一小段，这才插进了香炉里。
干燥的计时香燃烧的快，再加上那个男子偷偷掰下来了一小块，方行连一柱香的时间都没有，充其量只有三分之二的时间，恐怕连看也看不过来，又如何去挑选？
而若是平时，来选法器的弟子给出了丰厚的贿赂，这几个守阁弟子便不仅会直接遗忘了这计香时的事情，更会根据来人给出的贿赂，出言指点。
“下阶飞剑，材质百炼钢，内铭一法阵，灵气低微……”
“贮物指环，材质千锤金，空间一方……”
“紫铜飞剑，内铭三法阵，皆已损坏……”
方行不理会大耗子精几人的小动作，自顾自挑选着，目光所至，便对那法器的品质与特点了然于胸，轻松至极。果然像胖道人说的那样，有很多看起来很不错的法器都故意摆在了明眼处，只是内部法阵已经损坏了，若是真把它们选走了，那到手就是一堆废铁。
再好的法器，内部法阵损坏了，也就成了废铁，因为对于这些法器来说，内部的法阵甚至比它们的材质更值钱，损坏了之后，根本不值得去找人修复。
毕竟能修复其间法器的器师们，出手一次的代价都大得很，还不如重买一件。
“难道就从这些飞剑或是贮物指环里选一件？”

content_en:
The man next to the big rat spirit was startled, then suddenly became angry. Those who hold positions in the Magical Artifact Pavilion are far from being comparable to people like Fat Taoist who are miscellaneous supervisors. They all have connections or have paid a lot of money to get in. They hold the source of the magic weapon. When the disciples meet them, who would not be respectful? It is precisely because of this that they have developed their domineering character.
But how could he have thought that he would dare to curse a new disciple today after just scolding him a little?
Suddenly feeling angry, the man took a step forward and wanted to slap the kid away.
As soon as Fang Xing saw him like this, he knew that he was about to take action. He stepped back and laughed softly: "You can't force a bribe. Do you still want to take action with me? Do you still have any rules in the Taoist sect?"
The man's expression suddenly changed and he stopped abruptly.
Although the disciples who started the process all abide by the rules and tacitly gave them the spiritual stone, it was obvious that this matter was not open to the public.
Seeing that the boy in front of him was young but looked like an old man, he was really afraid that he would expose the matter...
"Haha, haha, why did we start arguing as soon as we met? This is not good..."
The big rat spirit looked at Fang Xing with a smile and said maliciously: "This junior fellow apprentice is not old, but he has a very strong temper. That's all. We were joking with you just now. You go in and choose a magic weapon. You need to wipe the bright spots on your eyes..."
"Thank you, senior brother!"
Fang Xing clasped his fists, ignoring what the big rat was saying, and dug in with his head.
When I went in and took a look, I was immediately surprised. This was no magic weapon pavilion. It was clearly a grocery store.
There are rows and rows of wooden shelves holding flying swords, talismans, spiritual weapons and other items. At first glance, it is dazzling. Each item seems to be quite extraordinary. Some of them have names and introductions in small print underneath, while others are just a pile on the shelf. There are messy talismans, flying swords, treasure bottles and even compasses. It is hard to tell whether they are good or bad.
At this time, Fang Xing finally understood why every newly promoted outer disciple was willing to bribe these people. It was because there were so many magic weapons here. From the appearance, it was impossible to tell which one was good and which one was bad, let alone its function. If you just randomly picked one among them, the possibility of missing it was too high.
When the big rat spirit and his two junior brothers saw Fang Xing's stunned look, they immediately sneered.
It's not like they haven't encountered people who were reluctant to hand over the spirit stones, but these people were all tricked by them.
Although the Magical Weapon Pavilion is full of low-level magical weapons that can be used by the disciples of the Qingyun Sect's outer sect, there are still two to three thousand pieces. Not long ago, the Qingyun Sect recruited disciples and has selected a large number of good quality ones. Now, more than half of the remaining ones are of low quality, or are simply damaged and cannot be used normally. Some of the good ones have been hidden in places where it is difficult to see them.
They didn't believe that this boy who contradicted them could pick something good!
"Hmph, these three bastards want to trick me, and I will open your eyes today..."
Fang Xing came back to his senses, sneered in his heart, and walked forward slowly.
"Junior brother, every disciple who comes to the Magical Artifact Pavilion only has time to choose one stick of incense. I lit it for you..."
The big rat spirit said with a smile again, and with a wink asked the man next to him to choose the driest stick of timer incense and burn it.
The man understood, and when he was lighting incense, he deliberately broke off a small section and then inserted it into the incense burner.
The dry timer incense burns quickly, and the man secretly broke off a small piece. Fang Xing didn't even have time to hold a stick of incense, only two-thirds of the time at best. He probably couldn't even look at it, so how could he choose?
And if in normal times, the disciples who came to choose the magic weapon gave generous bribes, these disciples guarding the pavilion would not only forget about it directlyAfter knowing the matter of planning the time, he would even give advice based on the bribe given by the visitor.
"Low-level flying sword, made of hundreds of steel, with a magic circle inscribed inside, low spiritual energy..."
"Storage ring, made of Thousand Hammers Gold, a space..."
"The red copper flying sword and the three magic formations with inner inscriptions are all damaged..."
Fang Xing ignored the small movements of the Big Mouse Jing and the others, and focused on his own selection. Wherever he looked, he understood the quality and characteristics of the magic weapon, and he felt extremely relaxed. Sure enough, as the fat Taoist said, there are many good-looking magic weapons deliberately placed in plain sight, but the internal magic circle has been damaged. If you really choose them, you will get a pile of scrap metal.
No matter how good a magic weapon is, if the internal magic circle is damaged, it will become scrap metal, because for these magic weapons, the internal magic circle is even more valuable than their material. After it is damaged, it is not worth finding someone to repair it.
After all, the weapon masters who can repair the magic weapon in it will pay a huge price for one shot, so it is better to buy a new one.
"Should we just choose one of these flying swords or storage rings?"
